card.name: Linking words in cancer regimen schedules
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "as" or "with" in oncology dosing schedules, just before "a single agent" or a named combination drug. Also numbers or dashes right before a phase such as Consolidation.

modes.label: "as" before single agent
modes.description: The word "as" after a dose and interval, leading into "a single agent".
modes.example: followed by IMFINZI 1,500 mg every 4 weeks<< as>> a single agent. ( 2.

modes.label: "with" in combination
modes.description: The word "with" after "in combination" before a chemotherapy drug.
modes.example: up to 4 cycles of VANFLYTA in combination<< with>> high-dose cytarabine consolidation

modes.label: Day numbers and dashes before phases
modes.description: A day number or dash in leukemia regimens just before the word Consolidation.

card.writes: It slightly suppresses "post"-type tokens, which suggests it blocks a word like post- after these linking words.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words in cancer drug schedules, such as "as a single agent" or "in combination with".
